sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
Fortune Wheel's core gameplay mechanic is centered around a spinning wheel that determines your winnings or losses. With each spin, the wheel lands on a randomly generated prize, and it's up to you to strategize and make the most of it. The game starts with a base amount of coins, and each spin has a chance to increase or decrease your fortune. The wheel is divided into different sections, each with its own prize or penalty. Some sections offer a chance to double or triple your winnings, while others may wipe out your entire fortune. The game's simplicity makes it easy to pick up, but its complexity lies in its unpredictability.

One of the key features of Fortune Wheel is its dynamic wheel, which changes with each spin. The wheel's design is simple yet effective, with each section clearly labeled and easy to understand. The game's core mechanic may be simple, but it's also extremely engaging. With each spin, you'll be on the edge of your seat, wondering what's next and hoping for the best.
